"'''LC-1'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the employ of the [[Linkaas Corporation]]. After he and three wingmen failed to stop the [[Lifeline (YT-1300 light freighter)|''Lifeline'']] from leaving [[Dohu VII]], their employer, [[Linkaas]], detonated destruct mechanisms in their fighters. LC-1 was [[Death/Legends|killed]] instantly.
